item.title: Learning Vercel AI SDK—Part 1
item.content:encoded: Learn how to set up a Vercel AI SDK project, install required dependencies and work with prompts, models and streaming.

item.title: The Great React Grid-Off: KendoReact vs. MUI vs. AG Grid
item.content:encoded: Curious how the best React grids on the market compete head-to-head? KendoReact vs. MUI vs. AG Grid—let’s see it!

item.title: 10+ Learning Resources to Kick-Start Your AI Journey
item.content:encoded: These 10+ resources can help you learn how to get started with AI as a developer.

item.title: Angular and Kendo UI MCP: Making Agents Work for You
item.content:encoded: See what’s possible when your AI assistant can use your actual tools to perform work for you: The Kendo UI for Angular AI Coding Assistant can connect with the Angular MCP Server in a truly intelligent way.

item.title: What Really Matters for Dev Students
item.content:encoded: Get some practical advice for beginners based on a senior developer’s 30 years of experience. These fundamentals can help root you in a career ready for change.

item.title: Blazor Basics: Implementing a Theme Switch in Blazor (Dark Mode)
item.content:encoded: Learn how to implement dark mode and a theme switch for Blazor web applications using standardized CSS features and no JavaScript code.

item.title: Stop Paying for the Same Answer Twice: Agent Cache in Fiddler Everywhere
item.content:encoded: Agent Caching in Fiddler Everywhere allows you to iterate as you build an agent without having to pay for every response when it hasn’t changed.

item.title: Accessibility (A11y) in .NET MAUI: What It Is and How to Implement It
item.content:encoded: It’s time to add accessibility into the early stages of your .NET MAUI development cycle. The POUR principles can help.

item.title: AI Crash Course: Hallucinations
item.content:encoded: While we can’t eliminate hallucinations entirely, there are still things we can do to reduce the chances of hallucinations showing up in our model’s responses.

item.title: How to Organize Minimal APIs
item.content:encoded: Minimal APIs arrived with .NET 6 and now, in Version 10, are already part of the daily routine for many developers. In this post, we'll explore best practices for organizing your Minimal APIs and see how Carter can help make them even cleaner, more modular and more elegant.

item.title: Guide to Creating an Angular-based Micro-frontend Application Using Native Federation
item.content:encoded: Micro-frontends break a large frontend application into smaller, independent components. Here’s how to do this in Angular with Native Federation.

item.title: 5 UX Tips for .NET MAUI Developers
item.content:encoded: Following these five UX tips as a .NET MAUI developer can help keep your app user-friendly and polished.

item.title: How to Build a NestJS AI Chatbot with Google Gemini
item.content:encoded: In this post, we will build a real-time FAQ chatbot for a tax management SaaS using Gemini 2.5 Flash and NestJS with Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream replies to the user. You'll learn how to set up Gemini and understand how context caching works.

item.title: Understanding the Architecture of a Prompt
item.content:encoded: Learn what prompt engineering is and how to create prompts so AI is best able to help you.

item.title: Coding Azure 22: Adding Configuration Information to an App Configuration Service
item.content:encoded: With the App Configuration service we built last time, we can now apply settings and configuration information. Here’s a look at how to do that and what the options are.
